close_reason: Removed DnsTxtNotFound variant from MtaStsError enum and its Display match arm. lookup_mta_sts_txt returns Ok(None) for absent records; the variant was never constructed anywhere.
description: mta_sts_error.rs defines DnsTxtNotFound but lookup_mta_sts_txt returns Ok(None) for a missing record, not Err(DnsTxtNotFound). Callers pattern-match on Ok(None) to mean 'no record'. The variant is never constructed anywhere. A maintainer who adds a new caller using DnsTxtNotFound will get no compiler pushback and will introduce a logic error (treating Ok(None) as the error path). Delete the variant or document clearly why it exists.
title: MtaStsError::DnsTxtNotFound variant is dead code — never returned
